title: I GUESS THAT'S WHY THEY CALL IT THE BLUES

[00:15.27] Don't wish it away,
[00:17.48] don't look at it like it's forever.

[00:36.62] And while I'm away, bust out the demons inside,
[00:45.95] and it won't be long before you and me run
[00:51.16] to the place in our hearts where we hide.
[01:01.49] And I guess that's why they call it the blues.
